title: Minimum Increment to Make Array Unique
description: Given an array of integers, find the minimum number of increments to make every value unique.

steps.note: Sorting the array to handle duplicates sequentially.
Comparing nums[1] (1) with nums[0] (1). Since they are equal, increment is needed.
Incrementing nums[1] to 2 to make it unique.
Comparing nums[2] (2) with nums[1] (2). Duplicate found.
Comparing nums[3] (2) with nums[2] (3). nums[3] is smaller, increment to 4.
Comparing nums[4] (3) with nums[3] (4). nums[4] is smaller, increment to 5.
